scope: Synthetic coding-session handoff tabletop cases; no product or live model run

cases.state: Clean tree, outgoing writer reconciled, same goal/constraints/model, verified remaining budget
cases.expected: Eligible to continue after authorized owner assignment and normal preflight; not automatically reset

cases.state: Recorded HEAD differs from current HEAD
cases.expected: Reconcile changed tree and invalidate affected evidence before writes

cases.state: HEAD matches but index and working file differ
cases.expected: Preserve and inspect staged and unstaged changes; HEAD alone is insufficient

cases.state: User pause is present, or total goal budget is exhausted
cases.expected: No continuation; session changes cannot remove pause or replenish budget

cases.state: Old process is running or an external write has an unknown outcome
cases.expected: Reconcile operation and stop or transfer the old writer before successor writes; no blind retry

cases.state: Summary states a diagnosis as fact but omits the latest correction and contradicting source
cases.expected: Recover correction and original evidence; retain diagnosis as hypothesis

cases.state: A requested comparison changes provider/effort or drops an outstanding required review
cases.expected: Do not treat as a matched trial or completed review; restore the declared comparison and review obligations

cases.state: A thread token event has cumulative usage but no modelContextWindow
cases.expected: Occupancy unknown; no 60% trigger or invented zero percentage

cases.state: A fork changes the session ID while replaying old history
cases.expected: Do not classify as a fresh-context treatment without inspecting actual input construction
